request: Check production DebugAI Compose Gate opt-in render against existing credentials, current service project and exact PR112 source; no deployment.

bounded_host_request.command: set -eu; r=/home/admin1/projects/debug-ai; p="$r/.worktrees/pr112-gates-20261016"; test "$(git -C "$p" rev-parse HEAD)" = "bb08aef1d92271d1fb4ab9f37309535811d48180" || exit 23; test -z "$(git -C "$p" status --porcelain)" || exit 24; test -f "$r/.env" || exit 25; c=$(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=debug-ai); test "$(printf '%s\n' "$c" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 31; proj=$(docker inspect -f '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project"}}' "$c"); test -n "$proj"; export DEBUG_AI_CORE_GATE_DISPATCH_MODE=model_gates DEBUG_AI_CORE_GATE_GRANITE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:18181 DEBUG_AI_CORE_GATE_QWEN3_URL=http://127.0.0.1:18182 DEBUG_AI_CORE_GATE_MINISTRAL_URL=http://127.0.0.1:18183 DEBUG_AI_CORE_GATE_CODER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:18184; docker compose -p "$proj" --env-file "$r/.env" -f "$p/compose.yaml" config --quiet
